findings.title: Current-root empty needs the pending-launcher guard at Stop as well as the drain
findings.evidence: R7 correctly says new admission may follow a current-root drain422 and guards check absent with no unreaped launcher456/589/764. But current-root empty457/811 counts check0 solely on the drain/EEXIST premise. A pending launcher for this attempt can be paused before SH acquisition and thus is absent from that drain. The new stop classifier589 can accept empty despite an unreaped launcher, contradicting its process-settlement proof. EEXIST only blocks that launcher while the directory remains. General467 no-admission-can-follow is true for sealed roots, false for the newly admitted current-root case.
findings.reproducer: Static supported-leftover control, no duplicate claim: pre-seed an empty home as the existinghome fixture, then let this bridge obtain its one claimfirst/spawn and hold that one launcher before opening/locking .admit or before mkdir. Create times out with decoupled cleanup; Stop wait expires while launcher remains held. Exclusive current-root drain succeeds and returnsempty. Unlike absent,589 imposes no unreaped-launcher guard for empty, so Stop may answerchecked and markbinding settled while its own launcher is alive. Resume subsequently: while home remains it exits71 (or observesqueuedcancel), preserving the home. No runtime probe was executed.
findings.callerLimit: The full retained relay matters: the paused launcher still holds fd3. The live relay cannot becomeclosed until that end closes, so retire step765 independently blocks immediate deletion. The serial attempt queue and queued TERM/KILL likewise constrain resumption. Therefore this review does NOT claim an actual late-home creation, false purgecompletion, provider call, duplicate claim, or executed deletion. A new instance uses sealed old roots, where drain fences later admission. The bounded defect is Stopchecked accepting a proof that does not cover its pending current-generation launcher, and unqualified future-writer prose.
